def _design(past, hold, x, dt, times, taus):
    later = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    survival = np.exp(-later[:, None] / taus)
    gap = hold[:, None] - past @ (-np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus) * survival)
    curve = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / taus), times[None, :, None] * x[:, None, :]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / taus, x))
    return (curve, rate)

def _align(train, test):
    labs, strata, raw, refs = (np.concatenate((train[k], test[k])) for k in ('lab_id', 'stratum', 'coupon_features_raw', 'ref_coupons'))
    aligned = np.empty_like(raw, dtype=float)
    for lab in np.unique(labs):
        take = labs == lab
        ref = refs[take]
        mean = np.nanmedian(np.nanmean(ref, axis=0))
        scale = np.nanmedian(np.nanstd(ref, axis=0))
        aligned[take] = (raw[take] - mean) / scale
    _, cells = np.unique(np.column_stack((labs, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    cell_means = []
    for cell in np.unique(cells):
        values = aligned[cells.ravel() == cell]
        counts = np.isfinite(values).sum(axis=0)
        cell_means.append(np.divide(np.nansum(values, axis=0), counts, out=np.full(raw.shape[1], np.nan), where=counts > 0))
    fill = np.nanmean(cell_means, axis=0)
    return np.where(np.isfinite(aligned), aligned, fill)
